title: KeyCompromiseRequest
description: POST /aab/v1/signing-keys/:keyId/compromises: declare a compromise, or widen its window (AAB-PLATFORM-09 section 8). statementSignature is present exactly when the statement names a signingKeyId.

statementSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the statement's canonical JSON: 64 bytes, standard base64, made outside the server.
